title: Sending Photos
drDigitalIntro:
You can share photos in a conversation — not just words!

- Tap the + button beside the message box to open the attachment menu.
- Choose Photos to see your photo library.
- Pick any picture and it sends instantly.
- The person on the other end can tap it to view it full-size.
- You can also attach files, videos, and voice memos the same way.

playgroundTask.goal: You sent a photo in a conversation

steps.say: Click on Jordan to open their conversation.
Click the + button next to the message box.

drDigitalSuccess: Photo sent! The + button is your attachment menu — use it any time you want to share a picture or file.
drDigitalHint: Click Jordan in the contacts list on the left. Then click the + button next to the message box and choose Photos.
